title: Spytial layout specification
description: A Spytial spec: constraints (structural layout) and directives (presentation). Spec language 2026-07-29, from spytial-core 4.4.2. This schema is stricter than the engine parser, which silently ignores anything it does not recognize — validating here is how a misspelled key or an out-of-range value gets caught at all. Fetch it from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/sidprasad/spytial-core@<tag>/docs/spytial-spec.schema.json; pin a tag, since the @main path is overwritten each release.

constraints.description: Structural layout: where nodes end up relative to one another.

directives.description: Presentation: how nodes and edges look, and what is shown at all.

oneOf.description: `size` here is deprecated — write it under `constraints`. Size fixes a node's geometry, which is what the layout solves over — not presentation layered on a solved layout. It is a constraint. The directives section still accepts it, identically, behind a deprecation warning.

`hideAtom` here is deprecated — write it under `constraints`. Hiding an atom changes what the layout has to place, and can make a spec unsatisfiable against the other constraints — it is a constraint, not presentation. The directives section still accepts it, identically, behind a deprecation warning.

textStyle.description: Styling for a label. Reused by every form that renders text — an atom's own label, attribute and tag lines, edge labels, and a group label.

size.description: Font-size tier relative to the node label: `large` renders bigger than the label, `normal` smaller, `small` smaller still. Default when omitted: "normal".

color.description: Any CSS color. Unset inherits the node label color, so dark mode still adapts.

lineStyle.description: Styling for an edge's drawn line. Reused by edgeStyle, inferredEdge, and a group's addEdge connector.

weight.description: Line thickness in pixels. Must be > 0; a non-positive or non-numeric weight is dropped.

highlight.description: A wider, translucent underlay drawn beneath the line. Orthogonal to color and pattern.

fillStyle.description: An atom's interior fill. Opt-in: the default look is unfilled, with only the border and label marking the node.

width.description: Outline thickness in pixels. Must be > 0; anything else is dropped.

iconStyle.description: An icon drawn on an atom. Every leaf is optional, including `path`, so a supertype rule can supply the icon and a subtype rule tune only its opacity.

path.description: A bundled icon name (`person`), an icon-pack reference (`bi:person-fill`), a URL, or a path. Resolved to a concrete URL or data URI at parse time. An iconStyle with no path draws nothing.

placement.description: `full` — the icon occupies the box, which stays transparent unless a fillStyle.color is given. `badge` — a small marker in the top-right corner, secondary to the label. Default when omitted: "full".

opacity.description: Alpha in [0,1]. Out-of-range values are dropped rather than clamped. Fade a `full` icon to use it as a watermark behind the label. Default when omitted: 1.

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.description: Place the two ends of each selected tuple relative to one another.

selector.description: Returns (source, target) pairs. The constraint applies to each pair. Selector arity: binary.

directions.description: Where the TARGET sits relative to the SOURCE. `directions: [above]` on selector `parent` places each tuple's target above its source. The `directly*` variants additionally enforce axis alignment. The direction is target-relative-to-source. Getting this backwards is the most common spec bug — transpose the selector (`~parent`) rather than flipping the direction if the relation reads the other way.

allOf.description: At most one of: above, below.
At most one of: left, right.
With `directlyAbove`, the only other value allowed is above.
With `directlyBelow`, the only other value allowed is below.
With `directlyLeft`, the only other value allowed is left.
With `directlyRight`, the only other value allowed is right.

hold.description: Negation. `never` asserts the constraint must not hold; `always` (the default) is the positive form.

cyclic.title: Cyclic
cyclic.description: Arrange the selected atoms around the perimeter of a circle, in the order the selector defines.

selector.description: Returns (a, b) pairs meaning "b follows a around the circle". Selector arity: binary.

direction.description: Which way the cycle runs. Default when omitted: "clockwise".

hold.description: Negation. `never` asserts the constraint must not hold; `always` (the default) is the positive form.

align.title: Align
align.description: Put the selected atoms on a shared horizontal or vertical line.

selector.description: Returns the pairs of atoms to align with one another. Selector arity: binary.

direction.description: `horizontal` gives the atoms a shared Y coordinate; `vertical` a shared X coordinate. An unrecognized value is a parse error.

hold.description: Negation. `never` asserts the constraint must not hold; `always` (the default) is the positive form.

group.title: Group (by selector)
group.description: Draw a hull around a set of atoms. For tuples (a, b), (a, c), … the group is keyed by `a` and contains {b, c, …}.

selector.description: First column is the group key, second the members. A unary selector builds a single unkeyed group. Selector arity: binary. A `group` with neither `selector` nor `field` is silently dropped — it matches neither grouping form. That is the one case where omitting this field is not an error but a no-op.

name.description: Display name on the group, and the handle an `inferredEdge` `draw` endpoint refers to. Required unless the constraint is negated (`hold: never`), where a name is generated.

addEdge.description: Draw a connector between the group key and the group: `togroup` points key → group, `fromgroup` points group → key, `none` draws nothing. Default when omitted: "none". The legacy boolean `true` is still accepted and means `togroup`.

points.description: The connector direction — the same value the bare string form carries. Default when omitted: "none".

oneOf.description: Block form also styles the connector, which is an edge and so takes the shared edge blocks: `{ points: <direction>, lineStyle: {…}, textStyle: {…} }`.

textStyle.description: The group's own label. Only `color` applies today — group labels auto-fit their box, so `size` is reserved.

hold.description: Negation. `never` asserts the constraint must not hold; `always` (the default) is the positive form.

group_byField.title: Group (by field)
group_byField.description: Group by indexing into the tuples of a relation. DEPRECATED — use `group` instead. A binary selector whose first column is the key and whose second is the members says the same thing without tuple indices.

field.description: The relation whose tuples are grouped. Its presence is what selects this form over group-by-selector. Because this field is the discriminator, omitting it does not raise an error — it re-reads the item as a group-by-selector, which then needs a `selector`. A `group` with neither is silently dropped.

groupOn.description: 0-based index of the tuple column to use as the group key.

addToGroup.description: 0-based index of the tuple column whose atom joins the group.

selector.description: Restrict which atoms this grouping applies to. Selector arity: unary.

hold.description: Negation. `never` asserts the constraint must not hold; `always` (the default) is the positive form.

size.title: Size
size.description: Set the width and height of matching nodes, in pixels.

width.description: Node width in pixels. Required, and must be a number greater than 0.

height.description: Node height in pixels. Required, and must be a number greater than 0.

selector.description: Which nodes to resize. Omit to resize every node. Selector arity: unary.

hideAtom.title: Hide atom
hideAtom.description: Remove matching atoms from the diagram.

selector.description: Which atoms to hide. Selector arity: unary.

flag.description: `hideDisconnected` hides every atom with no edges; `hideDisconnectedBuiltIns` hides only the disconnected built-in atoms (Int, String, …). Any other value is silently ignored.

atomStyle.title: Atom style
atomStyle.description: Style matching atoms. An atom is a composite of an interior fill, an outline, an icon, and its label, so each is its own block.

selector.description: Which atoms to style. Omit to style every atom. Selector arity: unary.

iconStyle.description: An icon drawn on the node.

showLabel.description: Whether the atom's label is drawn. Independent of the icon: `iconStyle.placement` controls the icon's geometry, this controls the label. Default when omitted: true.

edgeStyle.title: Edge style
edgeStyle.description: Style the edges of a relation: the drawn line, the label, and visibility.

field.description: The relation whose edges this styles.

selector.description: Apply only to edges whose source atom is in this set. Omit to apply to every source atom. Selector arity: unary.

filter.description: Apply only to the (source, target, …) tuples this selector returns. Use it to scope a directive to part of a relation, e.g. only the tuples whose value is True. Selector arity: n-ary.

showLabel.description: Whether the edge label is drawn. Default when omitted: true.

hidden.description: Hide the edge entirely while keeping the relation in the data. Default when omitted: false.

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: Render a relation as a key-value line on its source node instead of as an edge.

field.description: The relation to fold into the source node. Its edges are removed from the graph.

selector.description: Apply only to these source atoms. Omit to apply to every source atom. Selector arity: unary.

filter.description: Apply only to the (source, target, …) tuples this selector returns. Use it to scope a directive to part of a relation, e.g. only the tuples whose value is True. Selector arity: n-ary.

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: Add a computed key-value line to matching nodes, without touching the graph structure.

toTag.description: Which atoms receive the tag. Selector arity: unary.

name.description: The label shown before the value.

value.description: Evaluated per tagged atom; its result becomes the value. A unary result shows as `name: value`; an n-ary result shows one line per tuple, as `name[k1][k2]: value`. Selector arity: n-ary.

selector.description: Apply only to edges whose source atom is in this set. Omit to apply to every source atom. Selector arity: unary.

filter.description: Hide only the tuples this selector returns. Selector arity: n-ary.

inferredEdge.title: Inferred edge
inferredEdge.description: Draw an edge that is not in the data, computed from a selector.

name.description: The label drawn on the edge.

selector.description: Returns the (source, target) pairs to connect. May be unary when `draw` is given — the single atom then feeds both ends. Selector arity: binary.

draw.description: Reinterpret what each end attaches to, as `<end> -> <end>`. Each end is `_` (the atom itself, the default) or the name of a `group` constraint, in which case the end attaches to that group's hull. The left end applies to the first atom of each tuple, the right end to the last. Parsed strictly: a value that is not a string, or that does not contain exactly one `->`, is a parse error, as is a group name that no `group` constraint defines. `draw` never reorders — transpose the selector (`~connected`) to flip an edge.

color.description: Legacy inline line color. Deprecated — use `lineStyle.color` instead.

style.description: Legacy inline dash pattern. Deprecated — use `lineStyle.pattern` instead.

weight.description: Legacy inline line thickness. Deprecated — use `lineStyle.weight` instead.

highlight.description: Legacy inline highlight underlay. Deprecated — use `lineStyle.highlight` instead.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Assign an icon to matching atoms. DEPRECATED — use `atomStyle` instead. The single `showLabels` boolean drove label visibility and icon geometry at once. atomStyle splits those into two independent knobs, which is what makes a faded watermark, or a hidden label with no icon, expressible.

selector.description: Which atoms get the icon. Omitting it drops the directive entirely — it never means "every atom". Selector arity: unary.

path.description: Bundled name, icon-pack reference, URL, or path. Omitting it drops the directive.

showLabels.description: Whether the atom's label is drawn alongside the icon. Default when omitted: false.

atomColor.title: Atom color
atomColor.description: Set the color of matching atoms. DEPRECATED — use `atomStyle` instead. atomStyle expresses the same recolor and also reaches the fill, the icon, and the label. The rewrite is border-preserving, so an existing diagram is unchanged.

value.description: Any CSS color. Applies to the node's outline, not its fill.

selector.description: Which atoms to recolor. Omitting it drops the directive — it never means "every atom". Selector arity: unary.

edgeColor.title: Edge color
edgeColor.description: Style a relation's edges with flat, inline keys. DEPRECATED — use `edgeStyle` instead. edgeStyle groups the same knobs into the shared lineStyle/textStyle blocks that every other form uses.

field.description: The relation whose edges this styles.

selector.description: Apply only to edges whose source atom is in this set. Omit to apply to every source atom. Selector arity: unary.

filter.description: Apply only to the (source, target, …) tuples this selector returns. Use it to scope a directive to part of a relation, e.g. only the tuples whose value is True. Selector arity: n-ary.

style.description: Dash pattern. Trimmed and lowercased before matching, unlike `lineStyle.pattern`.

highlight.description: A wider, translucent underlay beneath the line.

showLabel.description: Whether the edge label is drawn. Default when omitted: true.

hidden.description: Hide the edge entirely. Default when omitted: false.
